methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly via WebFetch and corroborated via WebSearch and Capterra/PulseSignal where official pages returned 403 (Lodgify). Prices in GBP (Uplisting) and EUR (Smoobu) are kept in native currency with monthlyUsd=null to avoid conversion error; USD approximations noted in plan notes. Per-property and per-listing billing models are documented with the unit stated. Hostaway publishes no prices (multi-step quote form) so monthlyUsd is null. iGMS PRO/PRO+ corrected to the official $18/$21 base rates. A fabricated 'rentalduel.com' Lodgify corroboration URL was removed. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Lodgify
vendors.provenance: Lodgify's official pricing page returned HTTP 403; prices verified via WebSearch and cross-checked against Capterra and PulseSignal. The advertised per-property monthly-equivalent rates under annual billing (20% off) are Starter $16, Professional $40, Ultimate $59. Note that monthly-billing rates are materially higher: Capterra/PulseSignal show roughly $26 Starter / $42 Professional / $62 Ultimate. Numbers retained at the annual-equivalent figures Lodgify markets, but confidence is medium because the official page is inaccessible and third-party sources disagree on the monthly-vs-annual split.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Per property per month at annual-billing rate ($16); monthly billing is higher (~$26 per Capterra). Includes channel sync (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com) plus booking website. +1.9% booking fee on direct bookings. 7-day free trial. Annual saves 20%; bi-yearly saves 25%.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Per property per month at annual-billing rate ($40); monthly billing is higher (~$42 per Capterra). 0% booking fee on direct bookings. Adds dynamic pricing, automated messaging, analytics, phone support. Annual saves 20%.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Per property per month at annual-billing rate ($59); monthly billing is higher (~$62 per Capterra). 0% booking fee. Adds advanced analytics, team collaboration, dedicated onboarding. Annual saves 20%; bi-yearly saves 25%.

limits: Per-property pricing - each listing billed separately
Starter plan carries +1.9% booking fee on direct bookings
Monthly-billing rates are higher than the advertised annual-equivalent figures
7-day trial only (shorter than most competitors)
keyFeatures: Built-in direct booking website with payment processing
Airbnb Preferred+ / Vrbo Elite / Booking.com Premier partner
Dynamic pricing tools on Professional+
Multi-currency and multi-language booking website
bestFor: individual hosts scaling to a portfolio
hosts wanting an all-in-one website + channel manager
European and US vacation rental operators
enrichment.provenance: Official page returned 403; pricing corroborated via WebSearch, Capterra and PulseSignal. The $16/$40/$59 figures are the per-property annual-billing monthly-equivalent rates Lodgify advertises; monthly billing is higher. GDPR confirmed via Lodgify FAQ/marketing. SOC2 not publicly stated. Fabricated rentalduel.com source removed.
